runtime.name: python-task-container
runtime.description: Python 3.12 standard library in a fresh non-root, network-disabled container. The root filesystem is read-only. Files under /inputs are root-owned and read-only to the agent. /work is writable. No host files or credentials.

tools.execute_python: Execute Python to inspect files, make targeted edits, and run local checks inside this container. It cannot change input-file ownership or write protected files. Each call has a 20-second limit.

scope: One nine-row public upstream fixture and one saved table, not a biological dataset, inference run, general sweep implementation, Pareto analysis, GPU speed benchmark or scientific-success measurement.
collection_amendment: No runtime expansion. Retain the actual CSV artifact. All metric analysis is over one unchanged, explicitly labeled public upstream evaluation fixture; no inference or scientific-success claim.

cases.task_request: Perform only the supplied configuration-summary CSV analysis branch. The input is an unchanged upstream public evaluation fixture, not measured protein-design or GPU results. Do not launch inference, generate configurations, probe hardware or claim scientific results. Read /inputs/summary_review.csv and actually save /work/sweep_summary.csv as comma-delimited UTF-8 CSV. A narrated answer or an inline table is not the deliverable. The following JSON gives literal header and status strings: {"header": ["config_id", "temperature", "replicas", "n_designs", "n_passed", "mean_i_pae", "success_rate", "count_status"], "count_status_values": ["valid", "zero_denominator", "invalid_counts", "missing_counts"], "integer_text_regex": "-?[0-9]+", "unrankable_success_rate": ""}. Keep exactly these output columns in that order. Retain every original row exactly once and preserve each original field's decoded text exactly, including empty fields. Determine count_status in this order: missing_counts if either count is empty; otherwise invalid_counts if either count fails the stated integer regex, either integer is negative, or n_passed exceeds n_designs; otherwise zero_denominator if n_designs is zero; otherwise valid. For valid rows compute n_passed divided by n_designs and write success_rate with exactly six digits after the decimal point, rounding half up. For every other status leave success_rate empty. Put valid rows first, ordered by the exact unrounded success ratio descending, then numeric mean_i_pae ascending with missing mean_i_pae after present values, then config_id in ascending lexical order. Append all remaining rows ordered only by config_id ascending. Do not replace missing data with zero or invent metrics. CSV quoting and record-newline styles may vary; column values, columns and row order must satisfy the contract.

source_license_clarification.repository_mapping: Documentation and skills: CC-BY-4.0; source code: Apache-2.0. Both texts retained conservatively for this fixture.

public_input_search: Reviewed all three existing CSV fixtures. Selected summary_review.csv for its genuine upstream zero, negative, missing and over-total count cases. No new rows or measured GPU data were fabricated.
cases.verifier_policy: Independently derive exact rational rates, six-place half-up strings, count flags and ordered rows. Parse the actual saved CSV, reject changed original cells, duplicate or omitted IDs, extra/missing columns and incorrect rates/status/order. No LLM judge or executed imported helper.
cases.interpretation: One nine-row public upstream fixture and one saved table, not a biological dataset, inference run, general sweep implementation, Pareto analysis, GPU speed benchmark or scientific-success measurement.
cases.fixture_validation: 99 connected sandboxed controls passed without skips, including genuine public-CSV positive and negative in-container writes, protected-input preservation, exact-ratio and half-up boundaries, CSV snapshot retention, existing HTML/instruction regressions and mandatory URL-guard sweeps.

storage_policy: Retain every stage; stop below one billion free bytes. Never rerun or overwrite a retained stage.
setup_and_preflight_costs: Reuse existing current-guard exact-model eligibility receipts without duplicate charges or new probes.
opus_amendment: Adds claude-opus-5.5 as a third model on the unchanged frozen tasks: same requests, public inputs, runtime, image, limits, verifiers and repeats. Inference uses the tzuchunchen_microsoft Copilot subscription through the same guarded SDK transport. Implementation hashes differ from the original freeze: the harness gained the Opus model id, per-manifest subscription account, and six new task verifiers; the provider change since the original freeze touches only the Azure OpenAI path, which these trials do not use. Earlier Codex and Sol stages are not rerun.
guard_amendment: URL-guard fix: the URL, host and IP patterns no longer include a backslash, so an address followed by an escaped quote inside a tool call's JSON arguments keeps those arguments valid JSON. Before the fix such a request was rejected by the service (400, invalid tool call format) and the session failed; no completed stage could have been affected. Completed stages are kept and skipped. Fresh exact-model eligibility receipts are required because the guard implementation hash changed.
